content.text: Sweep is conclusive — "employment", "engage", "entice", "poach", "staff" surface nothing resembling a personnel-restriction covenant.

input.quote: Vendor acknowledges that Customer has made no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment.
input.rationale: PREFERRED position met: no non-solicit binds Customer. Exhaustive searches ("solicit", "hire", "employ", "employment", "induce", "recruit", "engage", "entice", "poach", "staff", "personnel") and reads of §§ 11, 12, 16 and 30 return no non-solicitation, no-poach or no-hire covenant on Customer or either Party. § 12.3 exceeds the playbook requirement by affirmatively recording that Customer has made no no-hire commitment and remains free to hire any person responding to general recruitment. The two failing deterministic checks (12-month duration; express general-solicitation carve-out) are phrasing tests for narrowing an existing restrictive covenant to the fallback; there is no covenant here to narrow, and inserting such language would import a restriction adverse to us. No redline is therefore proposed and the text stands unchanged. § 12.4 (Vendor-side competing-service restriction) is not flagged as it runs in our favour.
